stories.title: OM in hoger beroep tegen verstrekken namen euthanasiebrief aan ouders Milou

en.title: Public Prosecutor appeals decision to disclose names of doctors who supported euthanasia letter for Milou's parents
en.summary: The Dutch Public Prosecutor's Office is appealing a court ruling that ordered it to release the names of fourteen doctors who endorsed a letter about euthanasia for vulnerable patients. The parents of seventeen-year-old Milou Verhoof, who received euthanasia, had requested these names.

stories.title: Na dagenlang protest mag Maricarmen (87) terug in haar woning – en krijgen Spaanse huurders meer bescherming

en.title: After days of protest, 87-year-old Maricarmen allowed back in her home – and Spanish renters receive greater protection
en.summary: Following sustained public protest, an elderly Spanish tenant was permitted to return to her residence. Spain's government introduced new protections for renters as part of measures addressing the housing crisis.

stories.title: Vakbonden schorten acties op nu kabinet plannen sociale zekerheid intrekt

en.title: Trade unions suspend actions as government withdraws social security cuts plans
en.summary: Dutch labor unions FNV, CNV, and VCP suspended planned strikes after the government announced it would abandon cuts to social security benefits. Union leaders called the decision a significant victory.

stories.title: Na dagenlang protest neemt Spaanse regering maatregelen tegen woningcrisis

en.title: After days of protest, Spanish government implements measures against housing crisis
en.summary: Spain's government approved a package of measures addressing the housing crisis, including regulations named after an elderly woman evicted after seventy years in her home. The approval followed widespread public demonstrations.

stories.title: Rusland zat achter brandstichting bij defensiebedrijf, zegt Estland

en.title: Russia behind arson at defense company, says Estonia
en.summary: Estonian security services claim Russia committed arson at a defense facility in Tallinn that supplies weapons to Ukraine. The company produces unmanned military vehicles for Ukrainian ground forces.

stories.title: OM moest de namen van kritische psychiaters in euthanasiezaak 17-jarige Milou bekendmaken, maar gaat nu alsnog in hoger beroep

en.title: Prosecutor's office must disclose names of critical psychiatrists in euthanasia case of 17-year-old Milou, but appeals anyway
en.summary: Parents of a teenager who received euthanasia in 2023 for psychological suffering won a court order to reveal psychiatrists' names who had sent concerns to prosecutors. The prosecution is appealing on principle, citing need for confidentiality in citizen reporting.

stories.title: De hoeveelheid PFAS in bloed neemt bij de meeste Nederlanders af: een verbod lijkt te werken

en.title: Amount of PFAS in blood decreases in most Dutch people: a ban appears to be working
en.summary: Dutch health institute RIVM reports that PFAS chemical levels in most Netherlands residents' blood are declining as Europe develops a comprehensive ban. However, levels remain elevated in the Zeeuws-Vlaanderen region.

stories.title: Eerste verbod lijkt te werken: minder mensen met te veel chemicaliën in bloed

en.title: First ban appears to be working: fewer people with excessive chemicals in blood
en.summary: Nearly three-quarters of Dutch people have elevated PFAS chemical levels in their blood, down from near-universal prevalence previously. Despite improvements, many still have dangerously high PFAS concentrations.

stories.title: Minder pfas in bloed Nederlanders: eerste aanwijzing dat verbod werkt

en.title: Less PFAS in blood of Dutch people: first indication that ban works
en.summary: PFAS levels in the blood of Dutch residents have decreased, suggesting that restrictions on these chemicals are having a positive effect.

stories.title: Veroordeling van Willem Engel definitief, taakstraf voor opruiing blijft staan

en.title: Conviction of Willem Engel final, custodial sentence for incitement upheld
en.summary: The Supreme Court has upheld the conviction of Willem Engel, leader of Viruswaarheid, confirming his 60-hour community service sentence for incitement during the coronavirus period.

stories.title: Willem Engel definitief veroordeeld tot 60 uur taakstraf voor opruiing in coronatijd

en.title: Willem Engel definitively sentenced to 60 hours community service for incitement during coronavirus
en.summary: The Supreme Court has upheld the sentence against Willem Engel for incitement, which included urging followers to participate in a forbidden demonstration and disregard coronavirus measures.

stories.title: Viruswaarheid-leider Willem Engel terecht gestraft voor opruiing in coronajaren

en.title: Viruswaarheid leader Willem Engel rightfully punished for incitement during coronavirus years
en.summary: Willem Engel has been definitively sentenced by the Supreme Court to 60 hours of community service for inciting followers in 2020 to violate coronavirus rules and participate in a prohibited demonstration.
